responsibilities: Took on senior-level scope and technical leadership across multiple initiatives as Team Lead, from shipping new features for strategic clients to modernizing deprecated services and architecture.
Led Dependabot campaigns and security mitigation efforts that significantly improved monolith maintainability and security posture, helping support a major enterprise client deal.

Contributed to a Chrome extension for Care Coordinators (CCs), driving a substantial refactor that improved readability, test coverage, linting standards, developer workflows, and JavaScript bundle size.

Delivered end-to-end full stack work in a Node.js, Redis, React, and Elasticsearch web application, improving CC response times by 5% and removing dependency on a third-party tool to reduce operating costs.

Executed critical platform migrations (Ruby to Go, Snowplow to Amplitude, and Elasticsearch to internal LLM-powered capabilities), improving scalability, observability, and long-term product evolution.
Migrated AngularJS modules to Vue.js components in the member-facing app, reducing technical debt, improving code organization, and strengthening feature-flag implementation.
Migrated our primary client from Microsoft Dynamics NAV 2009 to a modern web UI, significantly enhancing performance, visibility, and communication.
Designed and implemented a RESTful architecture with Golang to extract metadata from Jira and generate dynamic reports for end users.
Mentored a junior developer, resulting in improved code quality by 30%.
Developed a Golang application to manage marketing campaigns. Integrated business data with the Mailchimp API for enhanced email campaign functionalities.
Led the conversion of significant portions of two major platforms from PHP (Laravel) to Vue.js components, resulting in improved loading speeds.

Designed and implemented reports, a RESTful web service and APIs for various departments using Google Maps, Google Charts, Highcharts JS, vue-chartjs and jQuery to increase action response and data analysis in real time.
Provided rapid support for new features and bug fixes, with over 1,550 contributions on GitHub in order to maintain and improve code quality.
Drove the internationalization and localization of a web administrative platform increasing our audience reach by 8%.
